command:
ulimit -S -c 0 || exit 125
ulimit -H -c 0 || exit 125
[[ "$(ulimit -S -c)" == 0 && "$(ulimit -H -c)" == 0 ]] || exit 125
[[ "$(ulimit -H -f)" == unlimited ]] || exit 125
ulimit -S -f 8192 || exit 125
exec /usr/bin/python3 -B -W error -c 'import os,resource,json
assert resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE)==(0,0)
assert resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE)==(8388608,resource.RLIM_INFINITY)
fds=[]
for name in os.listdir("/proc/self/fd"):
 try: os.fstat(int(name))
 except OSError: continue
 fds.append(int(name))
assert sorted(fds)==[0,1,2]
try: resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(resource.RLIM_INFINITY,resource.RLIM_INFINITY))
except ValueError: rejected=True
else: rejected=False
assert rejected
print(json.dumps({"CORE":resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE),"FSIZE":resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE),"open_fds":sorted(fds),"core_raise_rejected":rejected}))'
